scripts.prepare: husky || echo 'husky unavailable (e.g. Vercel install) - skipping git hooks setup'
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace professional-portfolio && npm run build --workspace job-tracker
scripts.check:bundle: node scripts/audit-bundle-budget.mjs apps/professional-portfolio && node scripts/audit-bundle-budget.mjs apps/job-tracker --js-limit-kb 400
scripts.check:clones: jscpd apps/professional-portfolio/src apps/professional-portfolio/e2e apps/professional-portfolio/scripts apps/job-tracker/src apps/job-tracker/e2e packages/ui scripts --min-lines 5 --min-tokens 40 --ignore "**/services/api/generated/**" --reporters console --exit-code 1
scripts.check:mutate:diff: node scripts/check-mutation-diff.mjs apps/professional-portfolio && node scripts/check-mutation-diff.mjs apps/job-tracker && node scripts/check-mutation-diff.mjs packages/ui
scripts.check:mutate:core: node scripts/check-mutation-core.mjs apps/professional-portfolio && node scripts/check-mutation-core.mjs apps/job-tracker && node scripts/check-mutation-core.mjs packages/ui
scripts.fix:all: npm run fix:fast && npm run lint:fix && npm run prettier && npm run verify:all
scripts.verify:push: npm run check:types && npm run check:case && npm run check:dead && npm run check:bloat && npm run check:arch && npm run check:clones && npm run check:vocab && npm run build
scripts.verify:all: npm run check:fast && npm run prettier:check && npm run check:types && npm run lint && npm run check:case && npm run test:cov -- --runInBand && npm run test:cov --workspace @career-hub/ui && npm run build && npm run check:bundle && npm run check:dead && npm run check:bloat && npm run check:arch && npm run check:clones && npm run check:vocab && npm run check:api-mocks && npm run check:audit
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace professional-portfolio && npm run test --workspace job-tracker && npm run test --workspace @career-hub/ui
